proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord / magic_item UnitRecord kind
proposed_widenings.justification: types.ts UnitRecord is SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord — no MagicItemRecord exists. The taxonomy has magic_item_root but the surface has never been widened to include the kind.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Armor (Half Plate Armor or Plate Armor), Very Rare — a magic item is the unit kind, and no UnitRecord variant can represent it without lying about kind/className/acquiredAtLevel.

proposed_widenings.name: passive_while_worn mechanics family
proposed_widenings.justification: The +2 AC bonus is always-on with no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no rest reset. The existing ClassFeatureActivationMechanics family requires all three. A 'passive_while_worn' family (or equivalent 'passive' family) is needed for effects that are continuously active while the item is equipped.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class.

proposed_widenings.name: reduce_forced_movement (effect)
proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction effect reduces the distance of forced movement by up to 10 feet. No v4 atom covers this: force_move emits forced displacement, modify_speed changes speed, and modify_ac changes AC. Reducing forced movement distance is mechanically distinct from all of these and needs its own atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: if an effect moves you against your will along the ground, you can take a Reaction to reduce the distance you are moved by up to 10 feet.

proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger: moved_against_will_along_ground
proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction trigger is 'moved against your will along the ground' — a forced-movement trigger. The existing ReactionTrigger union covers hit_by_attack_roll, targeted_by_named_spell, and any_of, but has no variant for forced-movement events.
proposed_widenings.evidence: if an effect moves you against your will along the ground, you can take a Reaction

proposed_widenings.name: attunement_slot resource in types.ts
proposed_widenings.justification: Dwarven Plate is Very Rare and requires attunement. The v4 taxonomy lists attunement_slot as a resource atom, but it is absent from types.ts UseCountResource and the broader resource type vocabulary. The item's lifecycle must consume an attunement slot.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Armor (Half Plate Armor or Plate Armor), Very Rare — attunement is implicit for Very Rare armor items per SRD.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: no MagicItemRecord kind exists in UnitRecord. Even if added, two further gaps would remain: (1) no passive mechanics family for always-on worn effects, and (2) no reduce_forced_movement effect atom. The +2 AC component could compose from the existing modify_ac effect atom once a passive family exists. The reaction component needs both the new trigger variant and the new effect atom. Attunement slot is a resourcing gap shared across all attunement items.
